title: draw_router outer-ring comment claims alternating single-LED angles, but both rings are complete (no alternation exists)
detail: For port_capacity 16, stride is 1, so the inner loop (k=(i*stride+12)%16) and the outer loop (k=(i*stride+4)%16) each cover all 16 positions: every angle draws both an inner (0.78r) and outer (0.94r) LED. The comment's alternation claim and '180°' are inaccurate; the +4 offset is visually inert since complete rings are rotation-invariant.
recommended_fix: Fix the comment: the offset is a 90° enumeration rotation, visually inert for full rings; the actual read is two concentric 16-LED rings (a literal 'double light ring', matching A3).

title: New junction port-ladder gate validates a jint-truncated value while the same diff uses jint_strict for the placement seps
detail: catalog.odin:365-368's new 4/8/16 ladder check reads a value parsed by truncating jint, so a decimal like 8.9 silently loads as 8 and passes the gate — the exact silent-truncation class the placement block in this same diff rejects via jint_strict ('a decimal sep truncates, never silently floors').
recommended_fix: Parse port_capacity with jint_strict (reject on !ok) before the ladder check, matching the placement-block precedent and the 2026-08-13 integer-only bar.
